subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Mr. Brown teaches English in a small mountain school.”?
options: One student said, "We did not do much."
Mandy's brother said, "Maybe Cookie doesn't want to be a star."
One student said his little sister learned to tie her shoes.
After the movie, one student said, "I understood more than I expected."
